answer: In a decentralized consensus network, AI agents can utilize a Sybil resistance mechanism known as Proof of Physical Location (PPL). Each agent generates a unique signal tied to its geolocation, verified through a network of trusted nodes situated at physical locations such as a wharf or inlet. An attacker attempting to create multiple fake identities would need to deploy a corresponding number of distinct physical devices, significantly increasing the cost and complexity of the attack, thereby securing the network.
